int inf_time[MAXN][MAXN];
int n, t;

int dx[] = {1, 0, -1, 0};
int dy[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};

void bfs(int x, int y) {
    for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a)
        for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b)
            inf_time[a][b] = INF;
    inf_time[x][y] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> fila;
    fila.push({x, y});
    while (!fila.empty()) {
        int cx = fila.front().first, cy = fila.front().second;
        fila.pop();
        for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) {
            int nx = cx + dx[a], ny = cy + dy[a];
            if (nx >= n || ny >= n || nx < 0 || ny < 0) continue;
            if ('0' <= m1[nx][ny] && m1[nx][ny] <= '9' && inf_time[nx][ny] == INF) {
                inf_time[nx][ny] = inf_time[cx][cy] + 1;
                fila.push({nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
}

vector<int> adj[MAXV];
int cap[MAXV][MAXV];

void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
    adj[u].push_back(v);
    adj[v].push_back(u);
    cap[u][v] = c;
    cap[v][u] = 0;
}

int tempo[MAXN][MAXN];
bool visited[MAXV];
int dist[MAXV];

bool bfs_level(int s, int t) {
    memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
    dist[s] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    while (!q.empty() && dist[t] == -1) {
        int v = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (auto &nxt : adj[v]) {
            if (!cap[v][nxt] || dist[nxt] != -1) continue;
            dist[nxt] = dist[v] + 1;
            q.push(nxt);
        }
    }
    return dist[t] != -1;
}

void bfs2(int px, int py) {
    memset(tempo, INF, sizeof(tempo));
    tempo[px][py] = 0;
    if ('1' <= m2[px][py] && m2[px][py] <= '9')
        add_edge(n * px + py, n * n + n * px + py, INF);
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.push({px, py});
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int x = q.front().first, y = q.front().second;
        q.pop();
        for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) {

        }
    }
    return total;

int dfs_max_flow(int v, int t, int f) {

    visitedNodes[v] = true;

        int pushed = dfs_max_flow(nxt, t, min(f, flowCap[v][nxt]));
        if (pushed) {
            flowCap[v][nxt] -= pushed;
